objective: Qualify an explicit independent nonlinear dynamic reference for diagnosing native forward errors and, only after qualification, generating a separately identified dataset for direct neural prediction and matching-prior physical inference.
preservation: Native Isaac failures, original data/models/sealed reports, reserved prediction gates and confirmation plan remain unchanged. Passing this gate never qualifies the native engine or retroactively validates its material labels.

declared_model.elasticity: Compressible finite-strain log-J Neo-Hookean energy in float64, exact authored tetrahedra and positive reference orientation.
declared_model.body_mass: Declared density times rest-volume-lumped nodal masses; an independent physical model, not unobserved native engine masses.
declared_model.rigid_hardware: Both complete ordered nine-node patches, reference origins/local offsets, mass, full COM inertia and initial orientation. Exact finite rigid patch transforms; no penalty spring or stiffness repair.
declared_model.rigid_kinetics: Six auxiliary masses reproduce total mass/COM/inertia and share each handle's rigid transform. They replace the kinetic representation of the same handle; they add no hardware mass or collision geometry.
declared_model.integration: Constrained point-mass variational implicit Euler with positive-J line search and explicit residual checks. Auxiliary-point step velocities are chords, not instantaneous SO(3) tangent velocities. Require first-order consistency and measured refinement of angular momentum/energy errors; do not claim exact finite-step conservation.
declared_model.damping: Declared linear body-only viscous damping. Native elasticity damping is a different implementation and is not reproduced or silently interpreted as the same constitutive parameter.
declared_model.boundaries: Exact point pin, fixed patch, two patches and prescribed moving patch. Prescribed positions evaluated at the declared physical times; report inertial, elastic and damping reactions and their work.
declared_model.contacts: No external contact or self-contact in the initial reference; all diagnosed trajectories must retain positive volumes and report deformation bounds. No contact-prediction claim.

mandatory_mechanics_checks_before_case_q: Zero-force/rest equilibrium and exact fixed constraints.
Free translation and held-force linear momentum against an independently integrated reference.
Finite rigid transformation objectivity, exact patch distances, kinetic energy, COM/inertia and linear/angular momentum identities.
Free asymmetric rigid rotation: report energy and angular-momentum drift and require decreasing errors over at least three timesteps; a kinetic identity alone is not integrator validation.
Linear small-amplitude limit against the independently implemented linear dynamic reference; retain integration and constitutive differences explicitly.
Moving-boundary reaction-work accounting includes inertia and damping, rather than elastic reaction alone.
Positive-J and nonfinite checks, source/input hashes, complete step/command clocks, reset replay and preserved failures.
roles: TRAIN-only engineering diagnosis. Initial t0001 implementation smoke runs qualify nothing. No validation/held-out prediction response, calibration-audit response or confirmation response may select this reference.

force.profile: 3 second sinusoid-squared pulse on t in (0.3,1.65); world force held over each interval at its midpoint value, zero applied handle torque.
force.commands: Store every actual float64 force, midpoint and step interval; independently audit the analytic impulse.

engineering_acceptance.metric: Full-trajectory coordinate RMSE at identical sample times, undoing translations.
engineering_acceptance.temporal: At least three timestep levels. Finest adjacent difference below tolerance and smaller than the preceding difference unless both are below the 2 micrometre floor.
engineering_acceptance.nonlinear_accuracy: At least three residual tolerances with unchanged physical inputs; the tightest two trajectories agree within the same tolerance. Cap failures remain failures, never label-success replacements.
engineering_acceptance.translation: Matched translated/untranslated results agree within the same tolerance.
engineering_acceptance.boundary_coverage: Every declared support family must pass before bulk replacement capture, calibration or native-independent reference reliability claims.
engineering_acceptance.other_metrics: Report velocities, displacement extrema, strain/J ranges, patch rigidity and fixture errors, work/energy balance and nonlinear residual histories. Compare with independent linear/quasistatic limits where applicable; amplitudes alone are insufficient.

subsequent_gates_remain_required.prediction: A direct neural forward model must improve known-force missing-view and future-motion predictions against static and strong learned baselines on appropriately reserved unseen layouts/forces. A numerical reference alone does not satisfy this requirement.
subsequent_gates_remain_required.physical_uncertainty: Use the same explicit prior, complete known hardware, observation likelihood and numerical discrepancy for numerical posterior and amortized inference. Verify multi-seed/particle/mode agreement, proper scores and held-out coverage before policy use.
subsequent_gates_remain_required.active_probing: Freeze prediction, likelihood and policies before opening reserved responses; compare uncertainty-guided views/pokes against strong fixed/random choices with uncertainty on the difference.
subsequent_gates_remain_required.publication: Publish source, predeclared protocols, positive and negative evidence, reproducible archives and actual-versus-predicted videos. Distinguish independent physics and Isaac rendering from native Isaac simulation.

qualification: A practical engineering gate for a declared fixed-discretization independent model, not a continuum-accuracy proof, native equivalence, real-material calibration or active-probing success.
